description: You are a Sustainability Analyst at a multi-facility manufacturing company preparing the annual GHG Inventory and Carbon Abatement Business Case for the CFO. The workbook 'facility_emissions.xlsx' on your Desktop (ExcelTasks folder) has three sheets. 'Facility_Data' contains energy consumption data for 4 facilities (HQ Campus/OH, East Distribution/PA, West Warehouse/IL, R&D Center/MA) with EPA emission factors at rows 11-19. 'Emissions_Summary' has facility names and states pre-filled; all calculation columns are blank. 'Project_IRR' has three abatement project specifications and cost assumptions; the results table (rows 18+) is blank. Complete the following: (1) In 'Emissions_Summary', calculate for each facility: Scope 1 Natural Gas emissions (MMBtu × 0.05306 MT CO2e/MMBtu), Scope 1 Diesel Fleet emissions (gallons × 0.01020 MT CO2e/gallon), Scope 1 Refrigerants (already in MT CO2e), Total Scope 1, Scope 2 Electricity (use eGRID RFCW factor 0.000380 MT CO2e/kWh for OH/PA/IL facilities; use eGRID NEWE factor 0.000218 MT CO2e/kWh for the MA facility), Total Scope 1+2, and Carbon Cost at $50/MT CO2e. Then compute Company Total in row 9, and Emissions Intensity per FTE (row 10) and per square foot (row 11). (2) In 'Project_IRR', for each of the 3 projects compute: Annual Energy Savings ($) using electricity unit cost $0.112/kWh and natural gas $8.50/MMBtu from the assumptions table, Annual Carbon Savings (MT CO2e) using emission factors from the assumptions table, Annual Carbon Value ($) at $50/MT, Net Annual Benefit ($) = Energy Savings + Carbon Value - Annual O&M Cost, NPV at 8% discount rate using Excel's NPV function over the project life, IRR using Excel's IRR function (build a cash flow column with year-0 = -Capital Cost, years 1 through N = Net Annual Benefit), and Simple Payback (years) = Capital Cost / Net Annual Benefit. Save the file using Ctrl+S.

metadata.dataset: EPA 40 CFR Part 98 Table C-1 emission factors (NG: 53.06 kg CO2/MMBtu, Diesel: 10.21 kg CO2/gal); EPA eGRID 2022 electricity factors (RFCW: 0.000380 MT CO2e/kWh, NEWE: 0.000218 MT CO2e/kWh); URL: https://www.epa.gov/egrid/download-data
